description: This Java class 'VersionRequest' is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to encapsulate the data for requesting a new version of a document, including optional notes and a file.

classes.name: VersionRequest
classes.description: A DTO class used for requesting a new version of a document, containing optional notes and a MultipartFile.

methods.name: VersionRequest
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize notes and file.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Returns the notes associated with this version request.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the MultipartFile associated with this version request.

methods.name: setNotes
methods.description: Sets the notes for this version request.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the MultipartFile for this version request.
